title: Sunset cruise!
text: I would definitely recommend this tour our skipper was very helpful and gave us plenty of recommendations, the night sunset views were absolutely spectacular!
author: Elizabeth_C

title: Wonderful experience
text:
Luis was excellent in every way. 
Hospitable, friendly and professional. 
Was a wonderful day. Would definitely recommend him.
author: Andrea_W

title: Super trip
text: Super amazing sailing turn with two stops for taking a bath in the sea. Weather was beautiful and the skipper super polite. I really recommend this expirience... Will do it again for sure when I am back in Barcelona. Thanks
author: pascal_h

title: Beautiful
text: We (me and my family) took a boat trip in January. The captain's name is Johann and is a very nice person. It was all perfect. Thank you.
author: lauraschoff

title: Boat sailing with friends
text: Very fun and enjoyable. We did the private 3-hour boat ride with Joan as skipper. The views of Barcelona from the sea are spectacular and the feeling of sailing alone with the wind is a pass. We will repeat!!
author: 88mireiag

title: Sailing boat ride
text: Recommended 100%! Very good vibes. It was all great! Thank you Joan driving your boat was an amazing experience!
author: Quest503690

title: Very good service
text:
Very comfortable boat and friendly crew. We enjoyed Barcelona from the sea listening our favourite songs.
We recommend this boat trip in Barcelona to everybody.
author: I3491DJjennyw

title: Amazing sunset trip
text: The boat is very beautiful and the skipper is friendly. We enjoyed the sunset time on board and it was amazing. I really recommend this sailing trip to everybody.
author: alex54786

title: Perfect boat ride
text: We sailed for 2 hours with my family and it was wonderful. The kids had a great time and the crew was lovely.
author: josemi54

title: Beautiful sailing trip
text: I booked the 2 hours sailing trip with my girlfriend and we really enjoyed it. The crew is very friendly and the views of Barcelona from the sea are amazing. I really recommend this company to everybody who wants to have a good time with family, friends or in a romantic way in a sailboat in Barcelona.
author: Michaelinoayma
